name: 65897 · Springfield, MO
findings: ZIP 65897 (Springfield) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65897 (Springfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
